question: Unsa ang dugang requirements sa OCBO kung 3-storey pataas ang building nga itukod?
answer:
Sa iyong kahibawan, kung 3-storey pataas ang building nga itukod, ang mga requirements sa Office of the City Building Official (OCBO) sa Davao City ang nakahusay nga:

1. Validation ng Occupancy Permit based sa Integrated Zoning Ordinance (2019-2028) (3-Storey Buildings and Above and 1,500 Building Floor Area and Above) [S1]
2. Validation ng Locational Clearance issued sa Office ng City Planning & Development Coordinator (CPDO) - Zoning Enforcement Division [S1]
3. Submit sa OCBO ang mga dokumento nga nakahusay nga:
   - 1 original copy ng Locational Clearance, kung maawo nga applicable [S4]
   - 1 original copy ng pictures ng building [S4]
   - 1 original copy ng Order of Payment [S4]
   - 1 original copy ng Official Receipt [S4]

Referma: [S1], [S4]

ground_truth: Conditional requirements state: construction/minor repair of buildings 3 storeys and above requires Construction Safety & Health Program, 1 original and 1 photocopy, with DOLE listed under Where to Secure. Boring and Plate Load Test Result/Report is listed if the structure is at least three storeys, 2 copies, with a licensed Civil/Geotechnical Engineer listed. For an additional storey, submit an affidavit that the foundation can carry the proposed additional floors, 2 originals.
